datasets.title: Philippines - Accumulated precipitation, Typhoon Haima - 11-20th October 2016
datasets.description: This data is created using GPM data. It contains the accumulated precipitation for the periods October 11-18th, October 18-20th and the total over both periods.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-accumulated-precipitation-typhoon-haima-11-20th-october-2016-zip]
datasets.details: This data has been sourced from GPM (https://pmm.nasa.gov/data-access/downloads/gpm)

lineage.description: Accumulated precipitation data was derived from NASA's Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) satellite observations during Typhoon Haima's passage over the Philippines (October 11–20, 2016). The data was processed by Netherlands Red Cross 510 to produce accumulated rainfall totals for two sub-periods (October 11–18 and October 18–20) and a combined total, distributed as shapefiles and CSV for disaster response and impact assessment purposes.

sources.name: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM)
sources.description: NASA's GPM satellite mission provides near-global precipitation measurements. The accumulated precipitation rasters for Typhoon Haima were derived directly from GPM data products.
